target_concept: Identify the role of Gaussian mean and variance in modeling the latent distribution of a VAE.

mcq.questionText: In a variational autoencoder, what does the Gaussian mean represent in the latent space?
options: The average (center) of the latent Gaussian distribution
The dimensionality of the latent space
A measure of how many training epochs have been run
mcq.correctAnswer: The average (center) of the latent Gaussian distribution
mcq.explanation: The mean of the Gaussian in a VAE indicates the expected (average) location of the latent variables, i.e., the center of the latent distribution. This aligns with the evidence stating that the mean is the average sample of the data distribution.
